name: Circus Audition
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Take the circus manager’s hat and give it to the first person.
Drag the monkey from the tree to the second person.
Use the hammer on the bicycle.
Give the unicycle to the third person.
Tap the leaves to drop an apple.
Give the apple to the acrobat.
Take the bag from the person under the tree and give it to the fourth person.
Move the dark cloud near the fourth person.
Drag the small person onto the big person.
Give the circus tent flag to the fifth person.
Give the horn to the last person to complete the level.
